ala.text: Bant is the shard of Alara where a council of archmages enchanted the land so that mortals who die there can reform as angels, and after Alara split its armies became less martial and more ceremonial.

Its archangel Asha gave her life fighting the demon Malfegor, and no angel took her title afterward, while the Order of the Skyward Eye unwittingly stirred fear and mistrust across Bant for an evil force.
When Esper's attack goes badly, Rafiq returns to Bant in time to warn of Malfegor's invasion, and Elspeth Tirel gives him the Sword of Asha and wings of light so that he slays the demon.

con.text: In Conflux, Bant is invaded by outsiders, and red mana from Naya and black mana from Esper flood in while the Order of the Skyward Eye sows mistrust and panic.
Bant's knight-captains find their ceremonial combat naive against massed armies, yet the nations of Bant forget their war and stand united against a common threat.
Even so, creatures from Grixis and Jund slaughter settlements and Bant's angels lose control as society collapses, until its borders merge with the other shards and it becomes part of New Alara.

arb.text: In Alara Reborn, the Conflux fuses the shards, so that Bant castles intrude on Naya and Grixis undead assault a Bant stronghold.
Refugees on the road to the Sun-Dappled Court hear of a warrior-mage who destroyed an army of the hellish invaders, and Elspeth's name is spoken around campfires as Bant's hope.
Some Naya Nacatl join Bant to help defend the stone walls raised to keep Jund, Grixis and Esper out.
